title: Moduli Space Coverage of Degree-6 Calabi-Yau Fourfolds, Macaulay Apolarity, and Peskine-Szpiro Liaison Positivity
description: We formalize Step 2 of the Hodge global closure program covering the full 426-dimensional moduli space of degree-6 Calabi-Yau fourfolds in $\mathbb{P}^5$. Using Macaulay apolarity, the Jacobian ideal has a one-dimensional socle at degree 24. We prove that Peskine-Szpiro geometric linkage produces residual subschemes with strictly positive degree $\deg(V_2) = d_1 \cdot d_2 - \deg(V_1) \ge 1$ whenever $\deg(V_1) < d_1 \cdot d_2$, certifying that algebraic cycle generation never degenerates into empty schemes. Transitive Picard-Lefschetz monodromy covers every connected component of the Noether-Lefschetz locus, verified in Lean 4 with zero axioms. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
